articles.title: No more free rides: it’s time to pay for space safety
articles.summary:

articles.title: China’s astronauts complete cave training amid preparations for moon missions
articles.summary:
China’s astronaut corps has completed a near month-long underground cave training, conducted in part to prepare for future crewed lunar landing missions.
